name: [NEW CARS🚓] Vehicle Crash Physics X 🚗
desc:
This is a openworld - freeroam experience where you can test the endurance from over 180 different vehicles!
Including Trucks, buses, sport cars, super cars, classic cars, JDM Cars, SPECIAL CARS & More!!
⚠️ This game uses HARDBODY destruction physics & systems.
⚠️ Not related with BeamNG or any other games.
⚠️ Pretty heavy game for Roblox despite it's "simplicity", higher connections are recommended for a better experience.

Last Update 2/10/26:
- Better SFX & VFX
- Optimizations
- MORE CHAOS

Don't forget to like, share and favorite the game 💫

Controls🚗: 
W-A-S-D: Movement
V (In vehicles): First Person
Y: Ragdoll
Shift: Sprint 
Shift (In vehicles): Handbrake 
H: Horn 
Z- X- C: Left/Both/Right Indicator 
Ctrl: Nitro, some vehicles only
Police cars🚓: 
J: On/Off siren lights 
R: Weil 
T: Yelp
